sentence: In Arabic the service names on the option cards, the consent screen and the ticket, and the clinic's name, contact and read list, have no Latin letter; in English they are the sample names; and switching language shows the other language's names

Decline moves the ticket to declined and says the clinic can still read what was shared until the person stops sharing, with a link to that control; the clinic can still read it until they do, and cannot after
"I don't want this any more" on the day-7 check declines the ticket with the same words, the same link and the same effect on what the clinic can read
/consent and /ticket redirect to /crisis while the block is set
The consent screen shows every optional element off, the ticket as needed, the equity opt-in off, sends nothing before Send, and previews what the clinic will see
The consent screen disables Send and says so when the service the person chose is not in the directory, and sends nothing; with the service back it can send
The request carries only the ticked elements, and the stored bundle is ciphertext holding only those
Stopping one element removes only it from the stored bundle; withdrawing deletes the bundle and moves the ticket to withdrawn
A summary draft is shared only after the person edits and approves it, and the approved and draft versions are logged as ciphertext
The day-7 check appears from ticket data, and Yes on an issued ticket reaches seen
Not yet leads to other options and a new consent; the child bundle holds only what the new consent allows
Delete everything revokes on the server before wiping, and when the server cannot be reached with data on it, deletes nothing
Delete everything wipes offline, with no request, when nothing was ever shared
Delete everything during an open crisis sends the unsent crisis record first, then wipes, and says so
Delete everything during an open crisis with no network deletes the unsent record with the rest, and says so
Choosing a clinic option and leaving the consent screen unsent keeps the support the person is already on
When the phone refuses to save a change on the options screen, the person is told
Settings names the plain-text crisis note in the tab, and the note holds only the trigger, an id and the time
The consent and ticket screens hold the plan's type, tap-target and no-overflow rules at 390 px
After a reroute the earlier ticket can be opened from the ticket tab and withdrawn, and the old clinic then reads 410
Stopping an element removes the approved summary and its logs and says so, and unticking an element a draft used clears its approval
An element unticked before Approve and ticked again before Send is still in the stored list of what the summary was built from, so a later stop removes the summary
A summary that is the fill-in template, written by the person, is built from nothing: unticking an element does not unapprove it and stopping an element leaves it, its own record and the notice alone
The draft request carries no content with the AI box unticked, and only ticked elements with it ticked
The equity opt-in shows as on once given and can be turned off in Settings, which clears it on the server

While the equity or the statistics choice is on, starting the app on a new day reads the person's own two choices once, which moves the day the server last heard from the phone to today, and a second start the same day asks nothing more

After the server has switched the equity choice off for a phone silent for the idle limit, opening Settings online shows the choice off with no panel for it and says once, in the page's language, that it was turned off because the phone was not used for 6 months, in the muted text colour of the help text beside it and at a contrast of 4.5 to 1 or better; the next visit says nothing about it, the consent screen starts with the choice unticked, and the phone made no equity request on the way

When the phone's note still has the group-totals choice on but the server has it off, the consent screen's box starts ticked; pressing Send asks the server, sends no group-totals request and no referral, unticks the box and shows, in view, that the choice is already off and the referral has not been sent; pressing Send again sends the referral and no choice; a box the person ticks on the screen sends the choice, in Arabic and English

When the phone's note still has the statistics choice on but the server has it off, the repeat check's box starts ticked; pressing Finish asks the server, sends nothing, unticks the box and shows, in view above Finish, that the choice is already off; pressing Finish again sends the totals with no choice; a box the person ticks on the screen sends the choice without the phone asking first, in Arabic and English

When the phone's background read of its two choices is answered 401, the phone does not register itself again and ask a second time, keeps no note of having reached the server, notes that the server did not know the phone, makes no read on the next start, and changes nothing else on the phone
The ticket shows who opened it, and says it could not be loaded rather than that nobody did
A refused save around choosing or sending is shown and never leaves the screen stuck, and a referral already sent is not hidden by a failed local write
A withdrawn ticket shows no open steps and no dangling separator, and a 7-day promise reads 7 days on the day it is issued
Preferences and equity options read in the person's language, and directory text sets its own direction
The consent screen matches its committed snapshot at 390 x 844
The ticket screen matches its committed snapshot at 390 x 844, with the code and QR masked
Approving a summary while an element it used is unticked keeps the approval, a hand-written summary is never unapproved by a tick, and the element is absent from what is stored
After a send whose local note failed, the ticket tab finds the ticket from the server's list; a failed list is an error, and a phone that never shared makes no request

Reminders are off until the person turns them on, come every 4 weeks to start and every 2 weeks if chosen, and a due one shows on the home screen in the reminder words alone until the next check-in is finished

With notifications allowed and reminders on, opening the app shows nothing while no reminder is due, and once one is due the notifier the layout mounts shows it through the notification adapter, in the reminder words alone

The number for text reminders is optional, refused unless international, held by the server only as ciphertext in its own row, labelled a sample, answered with a prepared sample that sends nothing, and deleted by removing it, by turning reminders off and by Delete everything
The repeat check is offered on the ticket exactly six weeks after the clinic saw the person and not a minute before, and its screen says when it opens until then

The repeat check ends on the two totals with the box to send them to the clinic unticked; finishing without it sends no totals, ticking it sends exactly the two totals and no answers, and a share the person ended offers nothing to tick
An answer above zero to item 9 of the repeat PHQ-9 opens the crisis screen as in any check-in, and the repeat check screen is then closed to the person until the crisis is resolved
The person's control to end a seen ticket moves it from seen to closed with the person as actor, and nothing is offered to end a ticket that has not been seen

When the phone cannot write its note that the statistics choice may be on, Finish sends nothing, the repeat check screen says that nothing was sent, no note is recorded and Finish stays in view at 390 by 844 with the message shown; once the phone can write again the same Finish sends the choice and the note is kept

On the repeat check's totals screen at 390 by 844, with the message that the choice's note could not be kept shown in the Finish bar, the line that says the answers stay on the phone is in view at first render with no scroll, at its own text size, with the bar over no part of it, and the message and the Finish button (at its 44 px height) are in view too, in Arabic and English

On the repeat check's totals screen at 390 by 844, with the message that the choice's note could not be kept shown, the whole message is in view at first render with no scroll, nothing sits over any part of it, and the Finish button is below it and in view at its 44 px height, in Arabic and English

When the reply to a repeat check sent with the statistics choice never arrives, the screen says it failed, the phone keeps its note that the choice may be on, and Settings still shows the statistics panel with its turn-off button

While the box to send the totals is unticked, the statistics box is disabled and looks unavailable (not-allowed cursor, flat ground) yet its title and help text read at 4.5:1 or better against their background, with no fading by opacity; ticking the send box makes it an ordinary enabled card

The repeat check's totals screen offers a separate box to count the totals in anonymous statistics, unticked by default, disabled and unticked while the box to send the totals is unticked, worded in both languages to say the totals count only in anonymous group figures of 10 or more and a clinic never sees the choice; the request carries the choice only with the totals, and the phone remembers it

Settings shows nothing about anonymous statistics while the choice is off; once on, it says so in both languages and one button turns it off at the server first, staying on and saying so when the server cannot be reached, and gone for good after it succeeds

The repeat check starts a fresh PHQ-9 at question 1 even when an unfinished one from before the clinic saw the person is on the phone, and both start links, and the link to the GAD-7, carry the exact moment the check opened

A day after the person releases a crisis screen, and not a minute before, home carries a neutral "how are you today" card and the next-day screen asks how they are; both work with the network cut, a worse answer puts Help now first and offers a GP or specialist, and the answer stays on the phone and nothing is written to the server
The next-day offer leads into the ordinary flow: the options screen matches on the phone, a fresh check-in reaches the consent screen, and a new crisis sends the next-day screen to the crisis screen

After the person chooses an anonymous session, a check-in, its result, a reload, Home, Settings and leaving the session make not one request to the API (any is refused and counted); the result says there are no support options in this mode, the check-ins live encrypted in the session's own database, and leaving is a separate confirmed step that deletes it and its key

The anonymous screen says in both languages what works, what it cannot do (no ticket, nothing shared, nothing kept on a server) and what stays on the phone; options, consent, ticket, claim, tamm, remeasure and next-day show that explanation in place of the screen, render nothing of it, and make no request to the API

At 390 px wide, the anonymous banner's "What this means" link is at least 44 px by 44 px, and Home, a walled screen and the check-ins list that fit the viewport still do not scroll with the banner on, in both languages
At 390 px wide, the "What this means" link in the anonymous result note is at least 44 px by 44 px and adds no sideways scroll, in both languages

A crisis opened in an anonymous session shows every number, takes a call and a "reached someone" answer, offers no hand-off, survives a reload on the phone, is neither sent nor queued, and Delete everything in the session removes the crisis block and the check-ins with no request to the API

During an anonymous check-in, on its result (and after a reload) and on the crisis screen, nothing in sessionStorage or localStorage holds an answer, score, band or result: the only plain notes are the session's random id and, with a crisis open, the crisis mark of trigger, event id and time; the check-ins are ciphertext in the session's database under a key no script can export

The anonymous session's database, with its ciphertext and its key, is deleted by Delete everything, by the next start of the app once the session's tab has gone (a closed tab could not wipe it), and by leaving the session, before the page moves on; a session that is still open in another tab is not deleted by that tab's start

With the browser's storage refusing every transaction when the trigger answer arrives in an anonymous session, the crisis screen still shows every number, the block holds through Back, a direct visit and a reload, "I'm safe right now" releases it, and the API sees no request

With the browser's storage never answering when the trigger answer arrives in an anonymous session, the crisis screen still shows every number, the block holds through Back, a direct visit and a reload, "I'm safe right now" releases it, and the API sees no request

While a crisis is open in an anonymous session the anonymous screen is not reachable (the address lands on the crisis screen), so the session can be neither left nor started, and the crisis mark says the crisis is an anonymous one; after the person releases the screen it can be left
